title: Unit 9: What Happened?: Third Conditional & Regrets
objective: Mampu membuat deduksi tentang peristiwa masa lalu menggunakan modal verbs (must have, can't have, might have, should have, shouldn't have) dan memahami perbedaan antara fakta dan opini dalam konteks misteri dan peristiwa yang tidak dapat dijelaskan.

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan cara membuat deduksi atau kesimpulan tentang peristiwa yang sudah terjadi di masa lalu. Kita menggunakan modal verbs khusus untuk menyatakan tingkat kepastian yang berbeda: 'must have' untuk sesuatu yang kita yakin benar, 'can't have/couldn't have' untuk sesuatu yang kita yakin tidak benar, dan 'might have/could have/may have' untuk kemungkinan. Selain itu, 'should have/shouldn't have' digunakan untuk mengkritik tindakan di masa lalu atau menyatakan penyesalan.
rules: Modal of deduction (certainty - positive): must + have + past participle. Contoh: 'Amelia must have run out of fuel.' (Saya yakin Amelia kehabisan bahan bakar)
Modal of deduction (certainty - negative): can't/couldn't + have + past participle. Contoh: 'She couldn't have survived the crash.' (Saya yakin dia tidak mungkin selamat dari kecelakaan)
Modal of deduction (possibility): might/could/may + have + past participle. Contoh: 'Amelia might have landed her plane on the island.' (Ada kemungkinan Amelia mendaratkan pesawatnya di pulau itu)
Criticizing past actions: should/shouldn't + have + past participle. Contoh: 'He should have thought about his plan more carefully.' (Dia seharusnya memikirkan rencananya lebih hati-hati)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Menggunakan Modal Present untuk Peristiwa Masa Lalu
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula menggunakan 'must be', 'can't be', atau 'might be' ketika berbicara tentang peristiwa masa lalu. Padahal untuk deduksi masa lalu, kita HARUS menambahkan 'have + past participle' setelah modal verb.
commonTrap.wrong: She must be at home yesterday when it happened.
commonTrap.correct: She must have been at home yesterday when it happened.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara Oliver dan Matt tentang kue yang hilang secara misterius di rumah mereka. Mereka mencoba mencari tahu siapa yang mengambil kue tersebut.

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: Yes, it was here an hour ago and now it isn't. Who's taken it?
lines.translation: Ya, sejam yang lalu ada di sini dan sekarang tidak ada. Siapa yang mengambilnya?

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.text: What about Dad? I heard him saying how hungry he was. In fact, I'm sure it must have been Dad.
lines.translation: Bagaimana dengan Ayah? Aku mendengar dia bilang betapa laparnya dia. Bahkan, aku yakin pasti Ayah yang mengambilnya.

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: No, he can't have eaten it. It was chocolate. Dad doesn't like chocolate.
lines.translation: Tidak, tidak mungkin dia yang memakannya. Itu cokelat. Ayah tidak suka cokelat.

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.text: That's true. I suppose Mum might have taken it. Maybe?
lines.translation: Itu benar. Kurasa Ibu mungkin yang mengambilnya. Mungkin?

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: No, it can't have been Mum. She's been out all morning.
lines.translation: Tidak, tidak mungkin Ibu. Dia keluar sepanjang pagi.

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.text: The dog! He must have jumped onto the table and eaten it. That dog's always doing things like that.
lines.translation: Anjingnya! Pasti dia yang melompat ke meja dan memakannya. Anjing itu selalu melakukan hal seperti itu.

speakingLab.context: Latihan percakapan tentang membuat deduksi terhadap peristiwa masa lalu. Tutor akan menanyakan situasi hipotetis dan siswa harus merespons menggunakan modal verbs yang tepat.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to practice making deductions about the past. Let me give you a situation: Your friend didn't come to school yesterday, and you saw their phone was off. What do you think happened?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: They must have been sick, or they might have had a family emergency.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good! Now imagine you found your front door open when you came home, but nothing was missing. What's your deduction?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Someone in my family must have forgotten to close it properly. It can't have been a burglar because nothing is missing.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent reasoning! Now let's practice regrets. Think about a time when you made a mistake. What should you have done differently?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I should have studied harder for my last exam. I shouldn't have stayed up so late the night before.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! You're using the structures very well. One more: Your team lost a football match 5-0. What might have been the problem?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We might not have trained enough. The other team must have been much stronger than us.

quiz.question: Complete: 'Amelia Earhart disappeared in 1937. She _____ run out of fuel over the Pacific Ocean.'
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'must have + past participle' untuk deduksi yang kita yakini benar tentang masa lalu. Dalam konteks ini, sangat mungkin Amelia kehabisan bahan bakar.

quiz.question: Which sentence shows the speaker is criticizing a past action?
options: He might have told the truth.
He should have asked for permission first.
He can't have known about it.
quiz.answer: He should have asked for permission first.
quiz.explanation: 'Should have + past participle' digunakan untuk mengkritik tindakan masa lalu atau menyatakan bahwa seseorang tidak melakukan hal yang benar.

quiz.question: Complete: 'The dogs can't be committing suicide because they _____.'
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'because' kita menjelaskan alasan dalam bentuk present simple karena ini fakta umum tentang anjing, bukan peristiwa masa lalu spesifik.

quiz.question: Choose the correct deduction: 'The school gates were closed at 9 am. You arrived at 9:30. So you _____ the gates open.'
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'can't have + past participle' untuk deduksi yang kita yakin TIDAK benar. Jika gerbang ditutup jam 9 dan kamu tiba jam 9:30, tidak mungkin kamu melihat gerbang terbuka.

quiz.question: What is the difference between fact and opinion?
options: A fact is something proven to be true; an opinion is a personal belief
A fact is always about the past; an opinion is about the future
A fact uses 'must'; an opinion uses 'might'
quiz.answer: A fact is something proven to be true; an opinion is a personal belief
quiz.explanation: Fakta adalah sesuatu yang dapat dibuktikan kebenarannya, sedangkan opini adalah keyakinan personal. Penting untuk membedakan keduanya saat membuat deduksi.

quiz.question: Complete: 'I had five slices of pizza! Now I feel sick. You shouldn't _____ so much pizza!'
quiz.explanation: 'Shouldn't have + past participle' digunakan untuk mengkritik tindakan masa lalu. Rumusnya adalah modal + have + past participle (eaten, bukan ate).
